# Gearbox Giants UK

> Specialist Automotive Transmission Rebuilding, Precision Remanufacturing & Free UK Recovery Service.

Gearbox Giants is the UK's leading transmission engineering specialist, offering complete manual, automatic, dual-clutch (DSG/S-Tronic/Powershift), and hybrid e-CVT gearbox reconditioning. We provide complimentary flatbed vehicle recovery, comprehensive 12-month unlimited mileage warranties, and dealership-grade repairs at up to 60% below franchised main dealer prices.

## Core Capabilities & Engineering Services
- **DSG & Dual-Clutch Transmission Rebuilds**: Full overhaul of VAG DQ200, DQ250, DQ381, DQ500, DL501, Ford Powershift 6DCT450, BMW DCT, and Mercedes 7G-DCT. Mechatronic circuit board repairs, hydraulic valve body testing, and wet/dry dual-clutch calibration.
- **Automatic Transmission Overhauls**: Component-level remanufacturing of ZF 6HP/8HP/9HP, Mercedes 7G-Tronic / 9G-Tronic, Aisin Warner, and GM automatic transmissions. Dynamic torque converter remanufacturing, planetary gearset replacement, and valve body bench testing.
- **Manual Gearbox Reconditioning**: 5-speed and 6-speed manual transmissions for passenger cars and light commercial vehicles (Ford Transit Custom, Mercedes Sprinter, Vauxhall Vivaro). Upgraded high-load tapered roller bearings and brass synchromesh rings.
- **4WD Transfer Boxes & Differentials**: Overhaul of Haldex units, BMW xDrive transfer cases, Land Rover / Range Rover transfer boxes, Mercedes 4MATIC, and Audi Quattro differentials.
- **Dealership-Grade Diagnostics**: Full electronic transmission scans, fluid analysis, hydraulic pressure logging, and dynamometer bench testing.

## Pricing & Commercial Model
- **Reconditioned Gearbox Rebuilds**: From £895 (compared to £4,000–£8,000 for brand-new main dealer crate replacements).
- **Turnaround Time**: Typically 48 to 72 hours from vehicle collection to delivery.
- **Warranty**: 12-Month Unlimited Mileage Warranty included on all rebuilt units covering parts and labour.
- **Finance Options**: 0% interest payment plans available.
- **Logistics**: Free flatbed vehicle collection from any UK address or local garage with return delivery and complimentary vehicle valet.
